title: Mean of the divisor-box face enumerator
statement: For Phi_z(n)=sum_{d|n} z^{b_n(d)}=prod_{p^a||n}(a-1+2z), prove a uniform Selberg-Delange asymptotic for sum_{n<=x} Phi_z(n) on compact subsets of Re(z)>0, with explicit Euler-product constant.
pvg_necessity: high for the natural observable; medium for the proof
nearest_known: general Selberg-Delange method, de la Breteche-Tenenbaum arXiv:2010.12929
main_risk: the result may be a routine application whose only novelty is the geometric observable

title: Interior divisor-box two-scale asymptotic
statement: For I(n)=Phi_0(n)=prod_{p^a||n}(a-1), prove D_I(s)=zeta(2s)zeta(3s)^2 H(s), with H absolutely convergent for Re(s)>1/4, and derive explicit x^{1/2} and x^{1/3}log x terms for sum_{n<=x}I(n).
pvg_necessity: high for definition and phase-transition interpretation
nearest_known: classical powerful-number counting and general Euler-product asymptotics; no exact weighted match found in initial search
main_risk: error term and priority may be covered by general results on weighted powerful numbers

title: r-margin interior hierarchy
statement: For fixed r>=1, let I_r(n)=prod_{p^a||n}max(a-2r+1,0), the number of divisor-box points at coordinate distance at least r from every facet. Prove D_r(s)=zeta(2rs)zeta((2r+1)s)^2 H_r(s), H_r absolutely convergent for Re(s)>1/(2r+2), and derive the first two scales of its summatory function.
nearest_known: general k-full number theory and Selberg-Delange-type factorization; exact geometric weight not located initially
main_risk: too broad for a first theorem and potentially subsumed by a general multiplicative-function theorem

title: Twisted margin-interior Euler factorization
statement: For a Dirichlet character chi mod q and fixed r>=1, prove sum_n I_r(n)chi(n)n^{-s}=L(2rs,chi^{2r})L((2r+1)s,chi^{2r+1})^2 H_{r,chi}(s), where H_{r,chi} is absolutely convergent for Re(s)>1/(2r+2), with all bad-prime conventions explicit.
nearest_known: standard twisted Euler-product extraction; no exact interior-box weight found initially
main_risk: mathematically routine and possibly too small unless paired with a nontrivial consequence

title: Torsion-character bias for interior divisor boxes in residue classes
statement: For fixed q,r and reduced a mod q, derive an asymptotic for sum_{n<=x,n=a mod q}I_r(n) whose x^{1/(2r)} terms are exactly indexed by characters chi with chi^{2r}=chi_0 and whose x^{1/(2r+1)}log x terms are indexed by chi with chi^{2r+1}=chi_0.
nearest_known: square-full numbers in arithmetic progressions, e.g. Munsch-Shparlinski-Yau arXiv:1810.02573, but not the same weighted torsion expansion
main_risk: fixed-modulus asymptotic may be a direct character decomposition of OLS-CAND-004; exact priority requires deep audit

title: Boundary divisor-box secondary terms
statement: For B(n)=tau(n)-I(n), derive the divisor main terms followed by explicit negative x^{1/2} and x^{1/3}log x corrections inherited from the interior count.
pvg_necessity: high for interpretation, low as independent proof
main_risk: not independent; should be a corollary rather than the selected target

title: Rank of truncated divisibility aggregation
statement: For N>=D, prove the D by N matrix 1_{d|n}, 1<=d<=D, 1<=n<=N, has rank D and kernel dimension N-D over characteristic zero.
main_risk: none; statement is immediate and not research-level

title: Exact recovery from full divisor aggregates
statement: For A_d=sum_{d|n,n<=N}a_n, prove a_n=sum_{k<=N/n}mu(k)A_{nk} and identify the exact truncated tail when only d<=D is known.
nearest_known: finite Mobius inversion on the divisibility poset

title: Mean normalized prime-factor mass energy
statement: For q>1 and M_q(n)=sum_p(v_p(n)log p/log n)^q, prove the mean of M_q(n) tends to 1/q.
pvg_necessity: medium for interpretation, low for proof
nearest_known: Billingsley Poisson-Dirichlet limit and quantitative work such as Arratia arXiv:1305.0941
main_risk: known consequence of prime-factor Poisson-Dirichlet convergence

title: Shape-conditioned residue Parseval identity
statement: For any valuation-shape selector W(n), express the variance across reduced residue fibers of sum_{n<=x,n=a mod q}W(n) as the corresponding nonprincipal character second moment.
pvg_necessity: medium for selector design, none for identity
main_risk: direct classical identity regardless of the chosen weight
